## Verified Municipal Contract Portfolio (17+ Multi-Year Contracts)

### Electrical Supply & Accessories
- **EED 05-2023/24 (City of Tshwane):** 36-month supply, delivery, and off-loading of low-voltage electrical cables, wire, and conductors across 50+ SAP-coded line items (effective Jan 2024).
- **AS 08-2023 (City of Ekurhuleni):** Supply, delivery, and off-loading of electrical items and accessories on an as-and-when-required basis with CPI escalation (Feb 2024 – Jun 2026).

### Heavy Plant, Fleet & Waste Vehicles
- **SS 01-2023/24 (City of Tshwane):** 3-year corporate hire of general construction and refuse removal vehicles (10,000L water tankers, 6m³–14m³ tippers, 7/8-ton dropsides, 12m³–19m³ rear-end loader compactors; effective May 2024).
- **SS 02-2023/24 (City of Tshwane):** 3-year corporate hire of general construction machines and equipment across primary and backup allocations (wheel loaders, excavators, articulated dump trucks, mobile cranes, motor graders, compactors, mowers; effective Apr 2025).
- **PU102/2022 (Pikitup Johannesburg / CoJ):** 3-year panel appointment for wet-rate plant and equipment (front-end loaders, TLBs, tipper trucks, skid-steer loaders) for illegal dumping and garden sites (awarded Oct 2022).
- **SS 02-2021/22 (City of Tshwane):** 3-year Joint Venture contract (Sithembe JV Bernidine) for general mechanical repairs and maintenance of light fleet vehicles (effective Jun 2022).
